Sarah is one of the kindest & compassionate vets I have ever encountered, I cannot thank her enough for her kindness to me & my little dog Minnie in July. She's a genuine animal lover with great empathy & patience for dogs aswell as their owners. Im very grateful Sarah was there to help me & my little dog Minnie as she crossed over the Rainbow Bridge 🙏 🤍🙏

Had a small emergency with my dog and end up having to go to that village vet ! Staff super helpful, first time in the clinic and there were just amazing… second time I got mixed up with time and arrived late unfortunately but they tried their best and were able to help me out even being all on me the delay … you can see when people like what they do ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This was my first time in this vets and I have to say it was the best experience in a vets I’ve had in ages ! The staff were so nice and let me and my cat wait in a quiet room at the back of the vets as there were a lot of dogs around and my kitty was a bit anxious. She relaxed right away when she saw her favourite treats. The vet himself was absolutely lovely and my cat loved him 😊. I am also on their pet plan now. I highly recommend as it can take a little pressure off affording a vet visit. Highly recommended this vets

Great place,super staff,highly recommended to all.
Thank you.
Excellent and very thorough   Nice and friendly too
Amazing service and such helpful and great staff. Helped me out with an emergency situation with my cat and were brilliant when it came it settling up the insurance plan. Highly recommend

The staff here are invariably helpful, obliging and communicative. I was fitted in at short notice for an appointment with my pet just before the vet who regularly treats her went on leave. I really appreciated being accommodated, as it is very reassuring to have my pet's regular checks done by the same vet who performed surgery on her two and a half years ago; and I was glad to have a chance to wish the vet, a valued friend, all the best for the period of leave.

Ovie on the team is genuinely the best vet we’ve been with! He’s so gentle, always answers all our questions patiently and looks after our girl! Shout out to the lady at the reception too, she’s also super nice. All up a great team.

No problems today in with Dash for
His yearly jabs. Lovely vet took care of
Him. Thanks all
Very happy to have chosen Village Vets Rathgar always lovely on phone and on person our puppy absolutely adores Vet Raluca.
Very efficient and friendly staff, Maisie (Cockapoo) was due her yearly booster & nails clipped, in and out in 20 minutes and no cost thanks to the Pet Plan great service.
